name: ACE-RISCV
summary: VM-based confidential computing framework for RISC-V with a formally verified security monitor providing attestation for confidential VMs.

name: Enclaver
summary: Open-source toolkit for packaging and running existing container workloads inside secure enclaves with attestation.

name: Sentient Enclaves Framework
summary: Framework for building confidential AI and cryptographic applications inside AWS Nitro enclaves, with attestation-bound model execution.

name: Apache Teaclave Java TEE SDK
summary: Confidential computing SDK letting Java applications run privacy-sensitive computation inside Intel SGX enclaves.

name: TrustFlow
summary: Zero-trust computing system that runs data preprocessing, machine learning and analysis inside TEEs with attestation-gated key release and data authorisation.

name: ML-Doctor
summary: Framework for running and comparing membership inference, model inversion, attribute inference and model stealing attacks against a target model.

name: diffpriv
summary: R package implementing generic differential privacy mechanisms, including sensitivity sampling for arbitrary analyst-supplied functions.

name: PrivateMultiplicativeWeights.jl
summary: Julia package generating differentially private synthetic data via the multiplicative weights exponential mechanism.

name: Spark Privacy Preserver
summary: Anonymising library for Apache Spark providing k-anonymity, l-diversity, t-closeness and differential privacy over large dataframes.

name: pyPANTERA
summary: Python package applying metric differential privacy mechanisms to obfuscate text, replacing words with privatised alternatives under a formal budget.

name: PrivacyLens
summary: Python library that audits an ML pipeline for privacy vulnerabilities, running membership inference, model inversion and PII-leakage checks against a trained model.

name: Noisegate
summary: Differential privacy gateway that lets an untrusted LLM agent query sensitive data over MCP, enforcing a per-analyst privacy budget below the model and shipping a runnable attack gallery.

name: DP-Sniper
summary: Machine-learning-based tool that searches for differential privacy violations in black-box algorithms, producing a concrete counterexample and an empirical epsilon lower bound.

name: go-tpm Remote Attestation
summary: Reference implementation of a TPM-based remote attestation protocol over gRPC, covering endorsement key verification, quote/verify and attestation-bound key sealing.

name: TF Encrypted
summary: Framework for encrypted machine learning in TensorFlow, running training and inference under secure multi-party computation without exposing the underlying data.

name: Inclavare Containers
summary: Confidential container runtime that launches OCI containers inside enclaves and provides remote attestation of the enclave runtime.

name: BlindAI
summary: Confidential AI inference server that runs models inside secure enclaves so neither the operator nor the client sees the other's data or weights, with client-side attestation verification.

name: Conclave Core SDK
summary: SDK for writing Intel SGX enclaves in Java, Kotlin and Python, with built-in remote attestation and constraint checking on the client side.

name: ACAI
summary: Extension of Arm Confidential Computing Architecture that brings GPUs and FPGAs inside the confidential VM's trust boundary, with a security analysis of the gaps in existing accelerator TEE designs.

name: Diffuse
summary: Peer-to-peer inference network that shards a model vertically across nodes, so each node holds only part of the weights and only encrypted activations cross the network.

name: OpenFHE
summary: Open-source library implementing the major fully homomorphic encryption schemes (BFV, BGV, CKKS, DM/CGGI) with bootstrapping and scheme switching.

name: tinynmc
summary: Compact pure-Python implementation of a secure multi-party computation protocol for arithmetic sum-of-products expressions with a non-interactive computation phase.

name: Transformer VM
summary: Deterministic transformer-shaped runtime that records its execution trace and proves the computation with a transparent STARK, cross-checked against native, Burn and ONNX engines.

name: Confidential Federated Compute
summary: TEE-hosted, reproducibly-built server binaries for federated learning and analytics, so clients can verify by attestation which code will process their uploaded data.

name: Verifiable MPC
summary: Zero-knowledge proof scheme layered on the MPyC framework so parties can verify an MPC computation was carried out correctly without learning each other's inputs.

name: Fleet Intelligence Agent
summary: Host agent for GPU fleets that collects device telemetry and attestation evidence alongside enrolled node identity, exporting via REST, Prometheus or OpenTelemetry.
